西幻：从鹰人部落到天使帝国最新章节_第 23章 出征第1页_西幻：从鹰人部落到天使帝国枫潇呀_热点小说网
> 第 23章 出征（第1页）
一名地精信使匆匆来到天堂山，走进白石之堡！
“翼人王，请您率领您勇敢的翼人军队，在秋叶将落之际，赶至费兰德中部，蒙恩平原会盟！”
“吾王已经决定，就在今年，秋叶纷飞之时，便举全族之兵反抗泰坦巨人的统治！”
“泰坦无道，诸族共伐之，事成之后，地精族愿与诸族共分大陆！”
“使者，请转告地精王，吾翼人族将遵守盟约，在约定的时间内，赶至蒙恩平原！”
地精使者闻言大喜，激动抚胸说道。
姜尤召集了部族之中，最勇敢的一万名成年翼人！
以及几百名战斗力强焊的超凡职业者，聚集在白石之堡外的浩大广场上。
一万多翼人站在广场之上，目露尊敬地看着他们的族长！
虽然外界皆称他为翼人之王，但他其实还没有加冕为王！
“血仇未报，如何敢称王？有朝一日，若能踏平天山，破灭鹰人王庭。我便在鹰人王庭的废墟上加冕成王！”
姜尤看着罗列在广场上的一万多名翼人，心中涌现出强烈的豪情！
他按着腰间的青铜长剑，运气大声道。
“很多年前，我们的祖先还是鹰人王庭的附属部落，在大荒中艰难求活。”
“每到一个十年，鹰人王庭便会来到祖先的高蛮山，强行征召几乎所有的族中青壮，投入到一场不知道多久的战争中！”
“每一次征召，便意味着一个家庭的破碎，几乎无人能归！”
“那瀚海森林，埋葬着我高蛮山祖先的累累尸骨，流淌着他们的鲜血和眼泪！”
“我的父亲，祖父，祖辈，都在那场看不到未来的战争中死去！”

“泰坦巨人和太古巨龙的战争，耗尽了我们祖先的血！”
说到这里，姜尤看了一眼眼眸通红，情绪高涨的族人们，继续说道。
“当我继任族长时，族内人员不过两百余人，皆是老弱病残！”
“当我成年，也被征召，参与了那场持续了不知道多久时间的战场！”
“我看到，泰坦巨人炫耀着他的滔天武力，不把我们当成生灵看待。我看到鹰人王庭，把我们当作可以随意消耗的炮灰，无数部落鹰人埋骨沙场！”
“从那时起，我便认识到，泰坦巨人和鹰人王庭的吃人本质！”
“于是，在第二次鹰人王庭征召之时，我杀死了鹰人王庭使者，带领族人来到这东海之滨！”
“我们在这里繁衍生息，逐渐强大！”
“我们获得了机缘，进化血脉，成为了更加强大的翼人一族！”
“而到今天，我们终于拥有了可以反抗泰坦和鹰人王庭的力量！”
“我的儿郎们，你们可愿意跟随我，讨伐泰坦，踏平天山！”

> Chapter 23 Departure (Page 1)
A goblin messenger hurriedly came to Heavenly Mountain and walked into the White Stone Castle!
"King of the Winged Men, please lead your brave Winged Army and rush to the center of Ferrand to form an alliance in Meng'en Plain when the autumn leaves are about to fall!"
"My king has decided that this year, when the autumn leaves are falling, we will raise the entire clan's troops to resist the rule of the Titans!"
"The Titan is unethical, and all races will attack it together. After this is accomplished, the Goblins are willing to share the continent with all other races!"
"Messenger, please tell the Goblin King that the Winged Human Race will abide by the covenant and rush to the Meng'en Plain within the agreed time!"
The goblin messenger was overjoyed when he heard this and said excitedly, stroking his chest.
Jiang You summoned 10,000 of the bravest adult wingmen in the tribe!
And hundreds of extraordinary professionals with strong combat capabilities gathered in the vast square outside White Stone Castle.
More than 10,000 winged people stood on the square, looking at their clan leader with respect!
Although the outside world calls him the King of Winged People, he has not actually been crowned king yet!
"How can I dare to claim the title of king if my blood feud has not been avenged? One day, if I can level the Tianshan Mountains and destroy the Yingren Royal Court, I will be crowned king on the ruins of the Yingren Royal Court!"
Jiang You looked at the more than 10,000 winged people listed in the square, and strong pride surged in his heart!
He pressed the bronze sword on his waist and said loudly.
"Many years ago, our ancestors were still a tribe affiliated with the Royal Court of Eagles, struggling to survive in the wilderness."
"Every ten years, the Yingren Royal Court will come to the Gaoman Mountains of their ancestors, and forcefully recruit almost all the young men of the clan to join in a war that lasts for who knows how long!"
"Every recruitment means a family is broken, and almost no one can return!"
"The vast forest contains the numerous corpses of my ancestors from Gaoman Mountain, and their blood and tears flow through them!"
"My father, grandfather, and ancestors all died in that war with no future in sight!"
"The war between the Titans and the Ancient Dragons drained the blood of our ancestors!"
Having said this, Jiang You glanced at the clansmen with red eyes and high emotions, and continued.
"When I succeeded as the clan leader, there were only about two hundred people in the clan, all of whom were old, weak, sick and disabled!"
"When I came of age, I was also recruited and participated in the battlefield that lasted for who knows how long!"
"I saw that the Titan giant was showing off his immense power and did not treat us as living beings. I saw that the Yingren Royal Court treated us as cannon fodder that could be consumed at will, and countless tribal Yingren buried their bones on the battlefield!"
"Since then, I have realized the cannibalistic nature of the Titans and the Yingren Royal Court!"
"So, during the second recruitment of the Eagle Court, I killed the envoy of the Eagle Court and led my people to the coast of the East China Sea!"
"We thrive here and grow stronger!"
"We got the opportunity to evolve our bloodline and become a more powerful winged people clan!"
"And today, we finally have the power to resist the Titans and the Yingren Royal Court!"
"My sons, are you willing to follow me, conquer the Titans, and level the Tianshan Mountains!"
